d: Watch as Firstpost breaks down the high-stakes military and strategic realignments unfolding at the Moscow summit, where Russian President Vladimir Putin is significantly bolstering relations with Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed. Abiy confirmed the delivery of twelve advanced Su-35 fighter jets—arriving a full year ahead of schedule—alongside plans for long-range S-400 air-defence batteries and a landmark nuclear power plant to diversify energy generation.
